content.text: {"grade": 6, "complete": false, "main_gap": "Tree-component argument omits the (one-line) justification that every piece inside the component's intervals is paired within that component, which is what makes the signed sum telescope into the x_{2j-1}-x_{2j} terms.", "errors": [{"description": "In the refinement-lemma lower bound, the identity |\u03a3_U a_i \u2212 \u03a3_W a_i| = \u00b1\u03a3(x_{2j-1}\u2212x_{2j}) \u00b1 x_r needs the fact that any piece lying in an interval of the chosen component is paired with a piece in the same component (otherwise its edge would merge components). This is used but never stated, and it is exactly what rules out stray unmatched pieces contributing.", "quote": "Expanding each \\(a_i\\) as the sum of its descendant final pieces, every paired edge in the chosen component contributes, up to sign, \\(x_{2j-1}-x_{2j}\\)."}, {"description": "Liu's marks are misstated: interval lengths \u03b4,2\u03b4,...,2^n\u03b4 correspond to marks at the partial sums (2^j\u22121)\u03b4 (i.e. \u03b4,3\u03b4,7\u03b4,\u2026), not at 2^j\u03b4. The stated mark set would produce different interval lengths. Clearly a typo, since (9) fixes the strategy, but as written it is inconsistent.", "quote": "Thus his marks are \\(2^j\\delta\\) for \\(1\\le j\\le n\\), all distinct and\nstrictly inside the stick."}], "notes": "Answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}\u22121) verified independently for n=1. Drafting lemma, subset-gap pigeonhole, graph/tree lower bound and overlay upper bound are all essentially correct, including edge cases (loops, parity, B=\u2205, coincident cuts). Section 5 is irrelevant padding but harmless."}
